title: How AI coding harnesses affect the same model
description: Published same-model comparisons of coding harness quality, time, cost, and token use.

methodology.question: With the model fixed, which harnesses offer the best tradeoffs between quality and resource use?
rules: Compare results only within the same study and comparison axis.
A Pareto front describes point estimates. It does not prove a statistically significant difference.
Higher quality is better. Lower time, cost, and token use are better.
Primary comparisons can be used for the main charts but still require their listed caveats.
Sensitivity comparisons have known limitations and should not be included in an overall ranking.
Insufficient-data comparisons contain fewer than two eligible results.
limitations: The sources use different tasks, scoring rules, timeouts, and accounting methods.
Source snapshots are not pinned to immutable versions.
Missing values mean that a source did not publish a usable value. They must not be treated as zero.
The dataset supports no universal harness winner.
